title: What an Australian tax invoice and adjustment note state
source: A New Tax System (Goods and Services Tax) Act 1999 ss 29-70 and 29-75; A New Tax System (Goods and Services Tax) Regulations 2019 s 29-70.01. Read 2026-10-09. Peppol PINT A-NZ is not built.

rules.text: Headed Tax invoice (Adjustment note for a credit), the supplier's name and ABN (modulus 89), the date, the GST, GST-free lines marked when some are taxed, and from A$1,000 the buyer's name and its address or ABN, on the page.
